description: Defines configuration structures for the 'du_low' component of a 5G NR software stack, including physical layer, logging, tracing, threading, hardware acceleration, HAL, and metrics configurations within the 'ocudu' namespace.

classes.name: du_low_unit_expert_upper_phy_config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the upper physical layer, including processing delays, decoder settings, SINR calculation, and channel estimation strategies.

classes.name: du_low_unit_logger_config
classes.description: Logging configuration for the DU low component, including log levels, broadcast, and file output settings.

classes.name: du_low_unit_tracer_config
classes.description: Tracing configuration for physical layer executor tracing.

classes.name: du_low_unit_expert_threads_config
classes.description: Thread configuration for the gNB app, including concurrency levels for various channels and processing types.

classes.name: du_low_unit_expert_execution_config
classes.description: Aggregates thread configurations for the gNB app.

classes.name: hwacc_pdsch_appconfig
classes.description: Hardware acceleration configuration for PDSCH encoding functions.

classes.name: hwacc_pusch_appconfig
classes.description: Hardware acceleration configuration for PUSCH decoding functions.

classes.name: bbdev_appconfig
classes.description: Configuration for BBDEV hardware accelerators, including type, ID, and buffer sizes.

classes.name: du_low_unit_hal_config
classes.description: HAL configuration, including optional BBDEV hardware acceleration settings.

classes.name: du_low_unit_metrics_config
classes.description: Metrics configuration, including enabling metrics collection.

classes.name: du_low_unit_config
classes.description: Main configuration structure aggregating all other configurations for the 'du_low' component.
